statements.status_notes: This DHI package backports the upstream fix from systemd v258.9 (commit a8feb2f23565d39df5c90a753c851c1934a53117) before building. The patch rejects non-normalized cgroup paths in the systemd-oomd ManagedOOM varlink handler, closing the path traversal that allowed local users to terminate arbitrary processes.
